effect_description_eng:
When this card would be played, by deleting 1 of your level 4 Digimon, reduce the cost by 6.
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
＜Retaliation＞ (When only this Digimon is deleted in battle, delete the Digimon it battled.) 
[All Turns] This Digimon can't digivolve.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 play cost 5 or lower [Kurata's Army] trait card from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
